description:
About the Role

Build the backend systems behind a fintech trading platform and AI coaching experience. You will help deliver reliable, real-time market data to users and connect the platform to trading venues.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build high-throughput, event-driven backend services for real-time data streaming.

  • Develop reliable systems that serve concurrent users and connect to trading venues.

  • Contribute to distributed systems and help shape the platform's backend technology.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 8 years of backend engineering experience and strong software fundamentals.

  • Professional experience with real-time streaming backends, high-throughput event-driven systems, and distributed systems.

  • Proficiency in Java or Kotlin; Python experience is also useful.

  • Experience with market data, trading venues, or another financial technology domain is a plus.

  • TypeScript and React experience is useful for full-stack work.

Location

Fully remote. Primary location: Bucharest, Romania.
